Which stable materials in the Materials Project have the widest band gaps?
SELECT formula_pretty, try_cast(band_gap AS double) AS band_gap_ev FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE try_cast(energy_above_hull AS double) = 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How did sulfur dioxide from U.S. power plants change from 1995 to 2023?
SELECT year(date) AS year, sum(so2_mass_lbs) AS so2_lbs FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE year(date) IN (1995, 2023) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
On which kinds of road did the most people die in 2022?
SELECT func_sysname, sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many FDIC-insured banks are still active today?
SELECT count(*) AS banks FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE cast(active AS varchar) = '1'
Which specialties report the most ownership interests in drug and device companies?
SELECT physician_specialty, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.op_ownership WHERE program_year = '2024' AND physician_specialty IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many formal water enforcement settlements were entered each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(settlement_entered_date, 7, 4) AS year, count(*) AS settlements FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_formal_enforcement_actions WHERE substr(settlement_entered_date, 7, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which hospitals and research centres host the most clinical trials?
SELECT facility, count(DISTINCT nct_id) AS trials FROM govblock_health.ct_locations WHERE facility IS NOT NULL AND facility <> '' AND facility IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many dockets involve an asbestos personal injury claim?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE nature_of_suit LIKE '368%'
Which states have the largest number of public schools?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_029 WHERE school_year = '2023-2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
When did the Department of Energy sign its first contract action of fiscal year 2020?
SELECT min(action_date) AS first_action FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2020'
Which departments flagged the most rules affecting small businesses in fall 2024?

SELECT element_at(split(acronym, ' | '), 2) AS department, count(*) AS rules FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE cast(publication_id AS varchar) = '202410' AND small_entity LIKE '%Businesses%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many QM9 molecules have no dipole moment at all?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.qm9_molecules WHERE dipole_debye = 0
Which states reported the most toxic chemicals released into the air in 2022?

SELECT _8_st AS state, round(sum(try_cast(_51_51_fugitive_air AS double) + try_cast(_52_52_stack_air AS double))) AS pounds FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many hospitals do worse than the national benchmark on central line bloodstream infections?
SELECT count(DISTINCT facility_id) AS n FROM govblock_health.cc_healthcare_associated_infections_hospital WHERE measure_id = 'HAI_1_SIR' AND compared_to_national LIKE 'Worse%'
Which Pennsylvania counties gave the most votes to the Republican presidential candidate in 2020?

SELECT county_name, sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'PENNSYLVANIA' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND party_simplified = 'REPUBLICAN' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did real GDP in Los Angeles County change from 2001 to 2024?
SELECT try_cast(_2001 AS double) AS in_2001, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS in_2024 FROM govblock_economy.bea_cagdp9 WHERE geofips = '06037' AND linecode = '1'
Which industries received the most Homeland Security contract money in fiscal year 2021?

SELECT naics_description, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many assistance actions did Veterans Affairs report in February 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_raw_source_assistance_transaction WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'Department of Veterans Affairs' AND action_date LIKE '202402%'
Which congressional candidates raised the most in the 2022 cycle?
SELECT cand_name, max(ttl_receipts) AS receipts FROM govblock_fec.candidate_summary WHERE cast(cycle AS varchar) = '2022' AND cand_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average rotor diameter of wind turbines built in 2022?
SELECT avg(try_cast(t_rd AS double)) AS avg_rotor_diameter_m FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE cast(p_year AS varchar) = '2022'
Which hours of 2022 saw the highest statewide electricity load in New York?

SELECT time_stamp, sum(try_cast(integrated_load AS double)) AS statewide_mw FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_zonal_load_hourly_palintegrated WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many jobs did Maricopa County, Arizona, have in 2022?
SELECT try_cast(_2022 AS double) AS jobs FROM govblock_economy.bea_caemp25n WHERE geofips = '04013' AND linecode = '10'
Which federal departments funded the research behind the most granted patents?
SELECT level_one AS department, count(DISTINCT patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_gov_interest_org GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many hours a week did private-sector employees work on average in December 2024?
SELECT value AS weekly_hours FROM govblock_labor.bls_ce_data WHERE series_id = 'CES0500000002' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
Do presidential campaigns raise more from small or large donations?

SELECT size_of_contribution, sum(try_cast(contrib_receipt_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_fec.presidential_map_contributions_by_size WHERE candidate_name = 'All Candidates' AND size_of_contribution IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of ChEMBL source papers published change from 2000 to 2020?
SELECT cast(year AS varchar) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_docs WHERE cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2000', '2020') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which specialties are most common among clinicians who can receive industry payments?

SELECT covered_recipient_profile_primary_specialty, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.op_covered_recipient_profile WHERE covered_recipient_profile_primary_specialty IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many megawatt hours of wind did the Texas grid produce in 2023?

SELECT round(sum(coalesce(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind AS double), try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind_without_integrated_battery_storage AS double)))) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'ERCO' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
Which hospitals reported the largest net losses for fiscal 2023?

SELECT a.itm_alphnmrc_itm_txt AS hospital, min(try_cast(n.itm_val_num AS double)) AS net_income FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_nmrc AS n JOIN govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_alpha AS a ON a.rpt_rec_num = n.rpt_rec_num AND a.wksht_cd = 'S200001' AND a.line_num = '00300' AND a.clmn_num = '00100' WHERE n.wksht_cd = 'G300000' AND n.line_num = '02900' AND n.clmn_num = '00100' AND cast(n.hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What share of Medicare clinicians are nurse practitioners?
SELECT cred, count(DISTINCT npi) AS clinicians FROM govblock_health.cc_dac_nationaldownloadablefile GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which manufacturers have faced the most federal vehicle defect investigations?
SELECT c6 AS manufacturer, count(DISTINCT c1) AS investigations FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_investigations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did coal-fired electricity generation change from 2010 to 2024?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.GEN.COW-US-99.A' AND period IN ('2010', '2024') ORDER BY 1
Which states have the most designated primary care shortage areas?
Bcd Hpsa Fct Det Producer Prices

SELECT primary_state_abbreviation, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.hrsa_bcd_hpsa_fct_det_pc WHERE hpsa_status = 'Designated' AND primary_state_abbreviation IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many particle entries does the Particle Data Group list?
SELECT count(DISTINCT name) AS particles FROM govblock_physics.pdg_pdgparticle
Which molecular formulas have the most conformations in ANI-1x?
SELECT "group", count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.ani1x_conformers WHERE "group" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many students were enrolled in U.S. public schools in 2024-25?
SELECT sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total'
Which drugs are tested in the most clinical trials?
SELECT name, count(DISTINCT nct_id) AS trials FROM govblock_health.ct_interventions WHERE type = 'DRUG' AND lower(name) NOT LIKE '%placebo%' AND name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many arXiv papers have high-energy physics theory (hep-th) as their main subject?
SELECT count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_papers WHERE primary_category = 'hep-th'
Which persistent, bioaccumulative toxic chemicals were released in the largest amounts in 2022?

SELECT _37_chemical AS chemical, round(sum(try_cast(_51_51_fugitive_air AS double) + try_cast(_52_52_stack_air AS double) + try_cast(_53_53_water AS double))) AS pounds FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022' AND _47_pbt = 'YES' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average band gap of the non-metallic materials in the Materials Project?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(band_gap AS double)), 2) AS avg_band_gap_ev FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE try_cast(band_gap AS double) > 0
Which power plants emitted the most carbon dioxide in 2023?
SELECT facility_name, sum(co2_mass_short_tons) AS co2_short_tons FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE year(date) = 2023 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Medicare nursing facilities have a real estate investment trust among their owners?
SELECT count(DISTINCT enrollment_id) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_skilled_nursing_facility_all_owners WHERE reit_owner = 'Y'
Which courts appear most often in judges' job histories?
SELECT organization_name, count(*) AS positions FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE coalesce(organization_name, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
On what day did the total public debt first top $30 trillion?
SELECT min(record_date) AS first_day FROM govblock_treasury.debt_to_penny WHERE try_cast(tot_pub_debt_out_amt AS double) >= 30000000000000
Which journals have the most articles in PubMed?
SELECT journal_title, count(*) AS articles FROM govblock_health.pubmed_articles GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
